proposal.reason: Main change is a full rebase of device collective kernels and dispatch generation onto NCCL-style primitives/templates, including new generated function/kernel tables and reachability guards (kernels). enqueue is additionally needed because function-id mapping, redop encoding (Min/Max fold to MinMax), and kernel selection failure handling changed in runtime planning/launch paths. kernel-plugin is additionally needed because ext-kernel device redop enum/ABI-facing contracts changed (ncclDevMax/ncclDevMin -> ncclDevMinMax), affecting plugin compatibility. build is additionally needed because the device-kernel build pipeline was replaced by generate.py/rules.mk generation and new dependency/object wiring in the device Makefile.
